substitutions.raw: Van der Brempt I. 7.0 Vojvoda M. 62'

raw: Van der Brempt I. 7.0 Vojvoda M. 62'

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Francesco Fourneau shows the yellow card to Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) for a heavy challenge.
90+5' A cross by Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
90+3' Nico Paz (Como) takes a shot from a mid-range free kick and the ball flies inches wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
90+2' Jose Luis Palomino (Cagliari) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Francesco Fourneau signals. Como earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
88' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
86' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
85' Yannik Engelhardt (Como) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
84' Patrick Cutrone (Como) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
84' The Cagliari players are exchanging some short passes.
83' Alex Valle will be replaced by Alberto Moreno (Como).
79' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Razvan Marin (Cagliari) replacing Antoine Makoumbou.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Zito Luvumbo departs the field of play to be replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari).
78' 3 - 1 Goal - 3:1! Nico Paz tees up Patrick Cutrone (Como) inside the box and he curls the ball into the left side of the net and past Elia Caprile.
78' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Francesco Fourneau to decide. The relieved Como players can finally celebrate.
78' Attention! Referee Francesco Fourneau straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
77' A goal, which was scored by Patrick Cutrone (Como), was disallowed due to offside.
75' Francesco Fourneau shows a yellow card to Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) for a tough tackle.
75' Patrick Cutrone (Como) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
74' Substitution. Alieu Fadera (Como) has come on for Lucas Da Cunha.
72' Davide Nicola decides to make a substitution. Michel Adopo will be replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
72' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) sprays a pass out to Alessandro Deiola, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
68' The yellow card is received by Michel Adopo (Cagliari).
68' The Como players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

65' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
62' Substitution. Mergim Vojvoda is replaced by Ignace Van der Brempt (Como).
62' Substitution. Maxence Caqueret leaves the pitch and is replaced by Yannik Engelhardt (Como).
61' Here is a change. Anastasios Douvikas is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Patrick Cutrone (Como).
61' Substitution. Gabriele Zappa walks off the pitch and Mattia Felici (Cagliari) comes on as a substitute.
60' We are about to witness a substitution. Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) is replacing Nicolas Viola.
59' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
57' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
57' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) serves up a nice cross, but Pepe Reina punches the ball away.
56' A pass by Maxence Caqueret (Como) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The linesman signals a throw-in for Cagliari.
55' Maxence Caqueret (Como) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
54' A player from Cagliari commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
53' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

53' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is out of play and Cagliari manage to earn a corner.
50' Elia Caprile (Cagliari) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.

48' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from the edge of the box. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.

47' Maxence Caqueret (Como) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Francesco Fourneau stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Cagliari.
47' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
46' Referee Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+4' Wasted opportunity! Nico Paz (Como) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
45+2' 2 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Gabriel Strefezza (Como) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the right post.
45+2' A pass into the penalty area from Gabriel Strefezza (Como) is intercepted by the defence.
45+1' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Pepe Reina stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
40' 1 - 1 Goal! Maxence Caqueret (Como) picks up a pass and gets to the edge of the box before clipping a brilliant lob over the goalkeeper and into the empty net. He makes it 1:1.
40' Referee Francesco Fourneau points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Como players celebrate.
40' Como score a goal, but referee Francesco Fourneau has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
40' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Maxence Caqueret (Como) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
39' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) tackles a bit over-zealously and Francesco Fourneau blows for a foul.
38' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

36' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
34' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Como.

33' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Pepe Reina leaps like a salmon to deny him.
33' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
29' The ball goes out of play and Como have been awarded a corner kick.

29' Nico Paz (Como) gets on the end of the resulting corner and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box towards the left post, but Elia Caprile makes a stunning diving save. The ball is out of play. Como will have a chance to score from a corner.
28' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is about to take a corner kick.
28' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Como.
28' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
27' Como seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
25' Referee Francesco Fourneau points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Cagliari players.
24' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Cagliari players aren’t happy.

22' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Nadir Zortea slips the ball through to Michel Adopo (Cagliari), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
21' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
18' Maxence Caqueret (Como) sees a yellow card from Francesco Fourneau after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
18' Neat passing move from Como in order to create new attacking opportunities.
17' The referee awards a corner and Gabriel Strefezza (Como) goes over to take it.
17' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Now Como have a corner.
14' Poor challenge! Adam Obert (Cagliari) is penalised for tripping and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle.
13' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Gabriel Strefezza (Como) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
10' A pass by Maxence Caqueret (Como) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is out of play. Cagliari will have a throw-in.
9' Adam Obert (Cagliari) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Corner kick. Como will have an opportunity.

7' Como win a corner. Maximo Perrone (Como) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Elia Caprile was alert and the score remains the same.
6' Francesco Fourneau interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Maximo Perrone (Como).
5' Maxence Caqueret (Como) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
2' The game is interrupted now, Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Como will have the kick-off.
Francesco Fourneau will referee today's match.
